text.tspan: A branch is a separate line of work that rejoins master when it is ready.
Commit 4 starts from a copy of
M is a merge commit — the one commit in the history with TWO parents: commit 3 and commit 5.
Nothing is lost and nothing is overwritten. Branching is how a team works on several things at once.
